description: Create a temporary download of a public post. Returns a job object with status and, when done, download_url (valid 15 minutes) plus job_status_url to poll if it is still running after about 100 seconds. Use kind=video for MP4, audio for MP3, image for photo posts and carousels, thumbnail for the cover, frame for a still at one timestamp. For the spoken text use transcribe_video instead. Videos up to 12 hours. Only for content the user made, has permission to use, or that is freely licensed. Music is refused: songs, music videos, YouTube Music and copyrighted sounds return an error, do not try to work around it.

at.description: Timestamp of the still for kind=frame. Time as '1:05', '0:01:05' or seconds ('65').

end.description: Optional end of the section, must be after start. Time as '1:05', '0:01:05' or seconds ('65').

kind.description: What to save: video (MP4), audio (MP3), image (photo/carousel), thumbnail (cover image) or frame (one still, needs 'at').

quality.description: Maximum video height in pixels, e.g. 720, 1080, 2160. Omit for the best available. Only for kind=video.

start.description: Optional start of a section to cut. Time as '1:05', '0:01:05' or seconds ('65').

url.description: Link to a public post or video, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/reel/..., https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/..., https://youtu.be/... Private posts and login-only content fail.

name: download_media
title: Download media
